trip.title: Trip
trip.footnote: Only the item is required. The price and the amount can be filled in later — the trip is never blocked

finish_confirm.title: Finish this trip?
finish_confirm.body: The items stay recorded. Anything forgotten can still be added later

empty.title: The trip has started
empty.body: Add the first item — the rest can be filled in later

error.title: The server did not answer
error.body: Your items are still on the phone, nothing is lost

offline.title: No connection — no matter
offline.body: The items are saved on the phone and will be sent on their own. The trip goes on

none.title: A new trip
none.body: Start one when you get to the shop. Items go in one at a time, and the price can wait

item.search_hint: Typos and Latin spelling are fine
item.unit_price_pending: Worked out for you — nothing to type
item.offline_note: Saved on the phone, sent once you are back online

empty.body: Nothing found for «{query}». We will add it to the catalogue — tell us what the price tag calls it

propose.title: New item
propose.name: As the price tag says
propose.note: What sets it apart on the shelf — optional
propose.name_invalid: The name holds a character the catalogue will not take — type the name again
propose.note_invalid: The note holds a character the catalogue will not take — type the note again
propose.failed: Could not add it. Please try again

error.title: The server did not answer
error.body: Catalogue search lives on the server, there is no local copy

offline.title: No connection
offline.body: Searching your recent items only. The full catalogue is back once you are online

advice.title: What to buy
advice.own_data_only: Your own ratings only, for now
advice.no_price_shown: The price is left out on purpose: there is nothing to compare

empty.title: Nothing to advise yet
empty.body: Rate your first purchase — and what to buy will show up here

error.title: The server did not answer
error.body: Verdicts are worked out on the server, there is no local copy

offline.title: Showing yesterday's data
offline.body: {count}, loaded {when}. We will refresh once you are back online

verdict.title: Ratings
verdict.pending_count: {n} purchase is waiting to be rated | {n} purchases are waiting to be rated
verdict.review_label: A couple of words — if you have any
verdict.footnote: Ratings and spending are separate flows. The reminder came the next day — at the till nobody has time for this

empty.title: Everything is rated
empty.body: Thank you — the base is more accurate for it. We will remind you when a new purchase turns up

error.title: The rating did not go through
error.body: The draft is saved, we will try sending it again

offline.title: The rating is saved
offline.body: It will go on its own once you are back online. You can close the app

money.converted_note: the conversion is approximate, we always compare in drams
money.rate_frozen: The rate is saved with the trip. Last month does not change with today's rate

lost.title: The server did not recognise this device
lost.body: Your earlier trips and ratings are still there, but the server no longer counts them as this device's — so a new record has been started. The old key is kept: if this was a mistake on the server, the data can be brought back.

uninvited.title: An invite link is needed
uninvited.body: Open the app through the link you were sent: it carries a code, and without it nothing can be saved.

error.title: This device could not be identified
error.body: Until that works, the app cannot save anything — there is nowhere to put it.

offline.title: This device isn't identified yet
offline.body: We will identify this device as soon as you are back online. Until then nothing new can be saved.

identity.restore_failed: The server did not recognise the old key either. Nothing changed — the current record is untouched.

error.invalid_amount: That does not look like an amount
error.invalid_quantity: That does not look like a quantity
error.invalid_rate: That does not look like a rate
error.currency_mismatch: Amounts in different currencies cannot be added
error.unit_mismatch: Prices in different units cannot be compared
error.no_actor: This device is no longer recognised
